Game Overview

Cyborg is a shooter title where step into the metal boots of a relentless warrior in Cyborg. Tactically manage resources and wield awe-inspiring weapons as you battle waves of enemies. Unlock upgraded gear while navigating a thrilling world of strategic combat, pulsing soundscapes, and pulse-pounding excitement. Will you survive the onslaught and rise to power?
